description: This PHP source file defines the VacancyDao class, which provides data access methods for Vacancy entities within the OrangeHRM recruitment module. It includes functions for retrieving, saving, deleting, and checking vacancies, as well as querying related data such as hiring managers and job titles.

classes.name: VacancyDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for Vacancy entities, providing methods to query, save, delete, and validate vacancies within the recruitment module.

methods.name: getVacancies
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Vacancy entities based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getVacancyListPaginator
methods.description: Creates and returns a paginator for the list of vacancies based on search filters.

methods.name: getVacanciesQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Builds a query with optional filters for vacancies, including job title, hiring manager, status, name, and publication status.

methods.name: saveJobVacancy
methods.description: Persists a Vacancy entity to the database.

methods.name: getVacanciesCount
methods.description: Returns the count of vacancies matching the search filters.

methods.name: getVacancyById
methods.description: Fetches a Vacancy entity by its ID.

methods.name: getExistingVacancyIds
methods.description: Returns a list of existing vacancy IDs from a given list.

methods.name: getHiringManagerEmpNumberList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of hiring manager employee numbers based on search filters.

methods.name: getVacancyIdList
methods.description: Returns a list of all vacancy IDs.

methods.name: getVacancyIdListForHiringManager
methods.description: Returns vacancy IDs associated with a specific hiring manager.

methods.name: isHiringManager
methods.description: Checks if a given employee number corresponds to a current hiring manager.

methods.name: getPublishedVacancyList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all published vacancies.

methods.name: isActiveJobTitle
methods.description: Checks if a job title ID corresponds to an active (not deleted) job title.

methods.name: isActiveHiringManger
methods.description: Checks if a hiring manager ID corresponds to an active employee without termination record.
